necessary_context.content: For integers d1,d2>=1, X is a closed convex subset of R^{d1}; f,g:X times R^{d2}->R are continuously differentiable. Minimize ell(x)=f(x,y*(x)) over x in X, where y*(x)=argmin_{y in R^{d2}}g(x,y). Algorithm initialization requires X nonempty. The inner problem is unconstrained.
necessary_context.name: Bilevel problem and domains

necessary_context.applies_to: Source setting for Eqs.(5)–(6); no performance theorem extracted
necessary_context.content: A1: for every x in R^{d1}, partial_x f(x,.) and partial_y f(x,.) are Lipschitz in y in R^{d2}, constants L_fx,L_fy; for every y in R^{d2}, partial_y f(.,y) is Lipschitz in x in X, constant bar L_fy; ||partial_y f(x,y)||<=C_fy>0 for all x in X,y in R^{d2}. A2: g is C2 in (x,y); for every x in X, partial_y g(x,.) is L_g-Lipschitz and g(x,.) is mu_g-strongly convex, mu_g>0; partial^2_xy g(x,.) and partial^2_yy g(x,.) are Lipschitz in y with positive constants L_gxy,L_gyy; A2.5 states these matrices are Lipschitz in x in X for every y in R^m, constants bar L_gxy,bar L_gyy>0 (m is the printed symbol, not silently replaced); ||partial^2_xy g(x,y)||<=C_gxy>0 on X times R^{d2}.
necessary_context.name: Assumptions 1 and 2

necessary_context.content: Write H(x,y)=partial_x f(x,y)-partial^2_xy g(x,y)[partial^2_yy g(x,y)]^{-1}partial_y f(x,y), the overbar partial_x f of Eq.(6). Eq.(5) identifies grad ell(x)=H(x,y*(x)); the paper invokes the unconstrained strongly convex inner problem. F_k=sigma(y0,x0,...,yk,xk); F'_k=sigma(y0,x0,...,yk,xk,y^{k+1}). Assumption 3 is transcribed in the Algorithm record. H is not partial_x f alone.
necessary_context.name: Surrogate and conditional histories
